afterVisit.hint: A set time after the booked time.

noShow.sentence: When a customer does not come

balanceOwed.name: Money is still owed

balanceOwed.sentence: {span} before a visit that is not fully paid

placeOpens.name: A place opens on a full slot

placeOpens.sentence: When a place opens on a full slot

notBack.name: A customer has not come back
notBack.sentence: When a customer has not come back for {days} days

refundAsked.name: A refund is asked for
refundAsked.hint: When the counter asks a manager for a refund.
refundAsked.sentence: When a refund is asked for

stockLow.name: Something runs low in stock
stockLow.hint: When an item reaches its low-stock number.
stockLow.sentence: When something runs low in stock

cashShort.name: Cash is short at close
cashShort.hint: When a counter closes with less cash than expected.
cashShort.sentence: When cash is short by {amount} or more at close

total.atMost: Only if the sale is {value} or less

visits.name: Times they have come

visits.atMost: Only if they have come {value} times or fewer

where.counter: Only if it was sold at the counter

owes.no: Only if it is fully paid

people.atLeast: If the group is {value} or more
people.atMost: If the group is {value} or fewer

total.atLeast: If the sale is {value} or more
total.atMost: If the sale is {value} or less

visits.atLeast: If they have come {value} times or more
visits.atMost: If they have come {value} times or fewer

where.counter: If it was sold at the counter

day.weekend: If the visit is on a Friday or Saturday
day.weekday: If the visit is Sunday to Thursday

wait.name: Wait
wait.hint: Let some time pass before the next step.

text.name: Send a text
text.hint: A text message to the customer's phone.

team.name: Tell the team
team.hint: A message to your staff, inside Counterfoil.

note.name: Add a note to the customer
note.hint: Staff see it the next time this customer comes.

offer.name: Offer the place
offer.hint: Text the next person on the waitlist and keep the place for them.

app.name: Send to another app
app.hint: Pass the details to a web address you give.

branch.name: If / otherwise
branch.hint: Do one thing if something is true, another if not.

then.note: add a note to the customer
then.offer: offer the place to the waitlist

sentence.more: {start}, {then}. Then {count, plural, one {# more step} other {# more steps}}.

cancelled.name: The booking is cancelled
cancelled.sentence: Stops if the booking is cancelled

checkedIn.name: The customer checks in
checkedIn.sentence: Stops if the customer checks in

paid.name: The balance is paid
paid.sentence: Stops if the balance is paid

quiet.label: Quiet hours
quiet.on: Texts and emails wait until 9 AM if they fall between 9 PM and 9 AM.
quiet.off: Texts and emails go out at any hour.

reason.noPhone: No phone number for this customer
reason.noTextYes: They did not say yes to texts
reason.noEmailYes: They did not say yes to emails
reason.sendFailed: The message could not be sent

stopped.switchedOff: Stopped: the sequence was switched off

run.held: Held until 9 AM by quiet hours

problem.name: Give it a name
problem.appAddress: Enter a web address that starts with https://
problem.branchEmpty: Add a step on one side
problem.endsOnWait: Add a step after this wait, or remove it

reminder.name: Remind customers the day before
reminder.desc: Fewer people forget, so fewer places go empty.
reminder.text: Hi {firstName}, see you tomorrow at {time} for {booking}. Your ticket: {link} — {venue}

confirm.name: Confirm an online booking by email
confirm.desc: An email with the ticket, right after they book online.
confirm.subject: Your booking for {booking} on {date}

balance.name: Ask for the balance before the visit
balance.desc: A text with the amount, then a nudge to a manager if it is still unpaid.
balance.text: Hi {firstName}, {owed} is still to pay for {booking} on {date}. Pay here: {link}

bigGroup.name: Tell a manager about a big group
bigGroup.desc: Know early when a group of 10 or more books.

review.name: Ask for a review after the visit
review.desc: A short thank-you with a link, while the visit is fresh.
review.text: Thank you for coming, {firstName}. How was {booking}? Tell us in one tap: {link}

thanks.name: Thank a regular customer
thanks.desc: A thank-you after their third visit, and a note for your staff.
thanks.text: {firstName}, thank you for coming back to {venue}. We are glad to see you again.

comeBack.name: Invite customers who have not come back
comeBack.desc: A friendly text after 60 days without a visit.
comeBack.text: Hi {firstName}, it has been a while. Come and see what is new at {venue}: {link}

noShow.name: Follow up when someone does not come
noShow.desc: A kind text an hour later, and a note on new customers.
noShow.text: We missed you today, {firstName}. Want another time for {booking}? Reply to this text and we will help.

waitlist.name: Offer a free place to the waitlist
waitlist.desc: When someone cancels a full slot, the next person in line gets the place.
waitlist.team: A place opened on {booking} at {time}. It was offered to the waitlist.

sorry.name: Say sorry when a booking is cancelled
sorry.desc: A short text so the customer knows it is done.
sorry.text: Hi {firstName}, your booking for {booking} on {date} is cancelled. We hope to see you another day. {venue}

stock.name: Tell me when stock runs low
stock.desc: A message to managers before something runs out.

cash.name: Tell me when cash is short
cash.desc: A message to managers when a counter closes short.

refund.name: Do not let a refund wait
refund.desc: Managers hear at once, and all staff after 4 hr with no answer.
refund.team: {customer} asked for a refund of {amount} on {booking}.
refund.teamAgain: A refund for {customer} has waited 4 hr for an answer.

text.service: Goes to every customer with a phone number. It is about their own booking.
text.yes: Goes only to customers who said yes to texts.

email.service: Goes to every customer with an email. It is about their own booking.
email.yes: Goes only to customers who said yes to emails.
